newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Former deputy U.N. spokesman to head London center.
newsitem.headline: Former deputy U.N. spokesman to head London center.

text.p: Ahmad Fawzi, a former deputy U.N. spokesman, has been appointed director of the U.N. Information Centre in London, the United Nations said on Tuesday.
Fawzi, 49, an Egyptian, takes up his post on Aug. 1, succeeding Alexander Borg Olivier of Malta.

He was deputy spokesman under then-Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali from 1992 to 1996. He had been press secretary and later chief of staff to Egypt's former First Lady, Jehan Sadat, from 1974 to 1984.
Before joining the United Nations he worked for many years in broadcast journalism, with Reuters Television and as editor and anchor for the nightly news on Egyptian television.
